newsitem.title: CANADA: Mineral Resources to bid for Anvil.
newsitem.headline: Mineral Resources to bid for Anvil.

text.p: Mineral Resources Corp said on Friday it intends to make a takeover bid for Anvil Range Mining Corp.

Mineral said it will offer three shares for every four Anvil shares and 285 of its own shares for every C$1,000 worth of Anvil's outstanding convertible debentures. The offer for the debentures is conditional upon the successful completion of the share offer.
The deal is subject to regulatory approval and Mineral Resources anticipates that the offer will be mailed in mid-February and will be subject to any change in material business of Anvil Range.
The offers will not be made to U.S. shareholders or to any shareholders in jurisdiction where the offer would be illegal, the company said.
Mineral said no offer is being made for Anvil's silver royalty units and the offer will not affect them.
"Our objective is to acquire control of Anvil Range," said Clifford Frame, newly appointed chairman and chief executive officer of Mineral Resources.
